learning_outcomes.text: Explain generative design and topology optimisation and when they help
Set design goals, loads and constraints that drive a generative study
Interpret and down-select among generated design candidates
Use AI assistants responsibly within a CAD and engineering workflow
Validate AI-generated geometry for manufacturability and performance
Describe the limits, data and accountability issues of AI-assisted design

integrative_case: A team uses generative design for a lightweight drone arm: set the loads and keep-out zones, add a printing constraint, generate and down-select candidates, then validate the chosen arm and record who signs it off.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
